tools.name: jurnal_get_current_user
tools.description: The Jurnal user the credential acts as: id, name, email, status, owner flag and roles. GET /public/jurnal/api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: jurnal_list_companies
tools.description: The Jurnal company (or companies) the credential belongs to: id, name, industry, address, tax number, currency settings and feature flags. GET /companies.

tools.name: jurnal_list_customers
tools.description: Customers with display name, addresses, email, phone, tax number and receivable balance. Paged. GET /customers.

tools.name: jurnal_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id (from jurnal_list_customers). GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: jurnal_list_vendors
tools.description: Vendors (suppliers) with display name, addresses, email, phone, tax number and payable balance. Paged. GET /vendors.

tools.name: jurnal_get_vendor
tools.description: One vendor by id (from jurnal_list_vendors). GET /vendors/{id}.

tools.name: jurnal_list_products
tools.description: Products and services: code, name, buy and sell prices, stock quantity, category, units, active flag. Paged. GET /products.

tools.name: jurnal_get_product
tools.description: One product by id (from jurnal_list_products). GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: jurnal_list_accounts
tools.description: The chart of accounts: id, number, name, category, currency and balance. Not paged. Use the ids as account_id in jurnal_get_general_ledger. GET /accounts.

tools.name: jurnal_get_account
tools.description: One chart-of-accounts entry by id. GET /accounts/{id}.

tools.name: jurnal_list_sales_invoices
tools.description: Sales invoices: number, customer, dates, status, total (original_amount) and balance due (remaining). Sort by transaction_date or remaining to find recent or unpaid ones. Paged. GET /sales_invoices.

tools.name: jurnal_get_sales_invoice
tools.description: One sales invoice with its lines, taxes and payments. GET /sales_invoices/{id}.

tools.name: jurnal_list_sales_orders
tools.description: Sales orders with customer, dates, status and totals. Paged. GET /sales_orders.

tools.name: jurnal_list_sales_quotes
tools.description: Sales quotes (offers) with customer, dates, status and totals. Paged. GET /sales_quotes.

tools.name: jurnal_list_receive_payments
tools.description: Customer payments received against sales invoices. Paged. GET /receive_payments.

tools.name: jurnal_list_purchase_invoices
tools.description: Purchase invoices (bills from vendors): number, vendor, dates, status, total and balance due. Paged. GET /purchase_invoices.

tools.name: jurnal_get_purchase_invoice
tools.description: One purchase invoice with its lines, taxes and payments. GET /purchase_invoices/{id}.

tools.name: jurnal_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: Purchase orders with vendor, dates, status and totals. Paged. GET /purchase_orders.

tools.name: jurnal_list_purchase_payments
tools.description: Payments made to vendors against purchase invoices. Paged. GET /purchase_payments.

tools.name: jurnal_list_expenses
tools.description: Expenses: number, date, beneficiary, status, total and balance due. Paged. GET /expenses.

tools.name: jurnal_get_expense
tools.description: One expense with its lines. GET /expenses/{id}.

tools.name: jurnal_list_journal_entries
tools.description: Manual journal entries (general journal). Paged. GET /journal_entries.

tools.name: jurnal_get_journal_entry
tools.description: One journal entry with its debit and credit lines. GET /journal_entries/{id}.

tools.name: jurnal_list_taxes
tools.description: The company's tax rates (PPN, PPh and so on). Paged. GET /taxes.

tools.name: jurnal_list_tags
tools.description: Transaction tags. Not paged. GET /tags.

tools.name: jurnal_list_payment_methods
tools.description: Payment methods (cash, transfer and so on). Not paged. GET /payment_methods.

tools.name: jurnal_list_warehouses
tools.description: Warehouses (needs a Jurnal plan with inventory). Paged. GET /warehouses.

tools.name: jurnal_list_product_categories
tools.description: Product categories. Not paged. GET /product_categories.

tools.name: jurnal_get_profit_and_loss
tools.description: Profit and loss (income statement) for a period: revenue, cost of sales, expenses and net profit by account. Dates are yyyy-mm-dd. GET /profit_and_loss.

tools.name: jurnal_get_balance_sheet
tools.description: Balance sheet as of end_date (yyyy-mm-dd, default today): assets, liabilities and equity by account. GET /balance_sheet.

tools.name: jurnal_get_trial_balance
tools.description: Trial balance for a period: opening, movement and closing balance of every account. GET /trial_balance.

tools.name: jurnal_get_cash_flow
tools.description: Cash flow statement for a period (operating, investing, financing). GET /cash_flow.

tools.name: jurnal_get_general_ledger
tools.description: General ledger for a period, optionally limited to some accounts (ids from jurnal_list_accounts). GET /general_ledger.

tools.name: jurnal_get_aged_receivables
tools.description: Aged receivables: what customers owe, bucketed by how overdue it is. GET /aged_receivables.

tools.name: jurnal_get_aged_payables
tools.description: Aged payables: what is owed to vendors, bucketed by how overdue it is. GET /aged_payables.

tools.name: jurnal_get_executive_summary
tools.description: Executive summary: key figures (cash, revenue, profit, receivables, payables) for the company. GET /executive_summary.

tools.name: jurnal_create_customer
tools.description: Create a new customer contact in Jurnal. This writes to the user's books (a customer can be archived or deleted later in Jurnal). Only display_name is required. POST /customers.

tools.name: jurnal_create_vendor
tools.description: Create a new vendor (supplier) contact in Jurnal. This writes to the user's books (a vendor can be archived or deleted later in Jurnal). Only display_name is required. POST /vendors.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jurnal_get_current_user, jurnal_list_customers, jurnal_list_vendors · Private data: jurnal_get_current_user, jurnal_list_companies, jurnal_create_customer, jurnal_create_vendor · Public sink: jurnal_get_current_user, jurnal_list_customers, jurnal_list_vendors, jurnal_create_customer, jurnal_create_vendor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jurnal_get_current_user, jurnal_list_customers, jurnal_list_vendors · Private data: jurnal_get_current_user, jurnal_list_companies, jurnal_create_customer, jurnal_create_vendor · Public sink: jurnal_get_current_user, jurnal_list_customers, jurnal_list_vendors, jurnal_create_customer, jurnal_create_vendor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
